archetype: Custom High-End Editorial (Blend of Swiss Brutalist & Luxury)

core_principles: Premium editorial-minimalist European feel. Rivals Oxbridge admissions firms, premium law firms.
Restraint over decoration. NO loud sliders, NO clip-art, NO rainbow gradients.
High use of negative space. Elements should breathe heavily.
Strong typographic hierarchy with tight tracking on massive serif headings.
Thin rules/dividers (1px solid borders) to structure content without heavy containers.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-light tracking-tighter text-[#0F1B2D] leading-[1.05]
hierarchy.h2: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-light tracking-tight text-[#0F1B2D] leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.overline: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium text-[#C75B39]

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use p-8, p-12, p-24, and p-32. Double the usual whitespace. Sections should be separated by py-24 or py-32.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Protocol Mode A: The 'Tetris' Grid for service showcases, using col-span-full, col-span-4, col-span-8 to create asymmetry.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Use 'border-t border-[#0F1B2D]/10' to separate sections instead of alternate background colors. Maintain the #F7F5F0 background everywhere.

header.style: Sticky, glassmorphism using 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F7F5F0]/85', with a 1px border-b border-[#0F1B2D]/10. Must contain EN/TR toggle.
header.links: Inter, text-sm, tracking-wide, text-[#0F1B2D] hover:text-[#C75B39] transition-colors

buttons.primary: bg-[#0F1B2D] text-[#F7F5F0] px-8 py-4 text-sm font-medium tracking-wide hover:bg-[#1A2E4C] transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: border border-[#0F1B2D]/20 text-[#0F1B2D] px-8 py-4 text-sm font-medium tracking-wide hover:bg-[#0F1B2D]/5 transition-all duration-300
buttons.accent: bg-[#C75B39] text-white px-8 py-4 text-sm font-medium tracking-wide hover:bg-[#A84A2D] transition-all duration-300

cards.style: Flat #FFFFFF or transparent background, 1px border border-[#0F1B2D]/10. Padding p-8 to p-12. NO drop shadows default.

icons.style: Thin-line. Set strokeWidth={1} or {1.5}. Color: #C75B39 or #0F1B2D depending on emphasis.

marquee.style: The 'Editorial Ribbon' Option A. Slow drift, subtle opacity (text-[#0F1B2D]/40), uppercase tracked out text or thin logos separating sections.

motion.scroll_reveal: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }} viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-10%' }}
motion.image_parallax: Use Framer Motion useScroll and useTransform to move images slightly on scroll (y: -5% to 5%).
motion.stats_count_up: Use framer-motion to count up stats when in view. Font should be massive Cormorant Garamond.

hero_image.description: Milan Cathedral - use in a massive 80vh container with slight parallax. No heavy black overlay, use a subtle gradient from #F7F5F0 to transparent if text needs contrast, or place text adjacent.

architecture_bento_1.description: Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II tall shot. Perfect for tall vertical bento box.

campus_street.description: Narrow street in Turin, warm daylight. Good for About Us or Life in Italy section.

library.description: Modern expansive library. Perfect for 'İtalya'da Eğitim' hub header.

pages_structure: İtalya'da Eğitim (Education Hub: Universities, DSU, Applications)

testing.mandate: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI in React using Tailwind CSS. Do NOT use Shadcn UI for the marketing layout, use pure HTML/Tailwind for the sophisticated overlapping/bento layouts as per the rules.
You MAY use Shadcn UI strictly for the forms (Contact form, Webinar Registration) but override their default Vercel-like styles to match the editorial bone/navy theme.
Integrate lucide-react with strokeWidth={1} for all iconography.
Ensure the EN/TR language toggle is present in the header. (Mock the actual translation state for now).
Implement the 'stats count up' using framer-motion.
Inject the provided Unsplash/Pexels URLs directly. NEVER use placeholder image services.
Strictly follow the color hex codes provided in this JSON.
Remember to inject Google Fonts via next/font or standard <link> in index.css: Cormorant Garamond (300,400,500,600) and Inter (300,400,500).
